@Path("/realms") — every realm-scoped endpoint hangs off this root

svg.text: reconciles via Admin REST API (ordinary client)

AuthorizationTokenService · DefaultPolicyEvaluator · Policy Providers (role / user / client / group / time / regex / js / aggregated) → RPT — also authorizes the Admin REST API itself (FGAP)
